requirements.title: College major overlap and grading
requirements.summary: Each major must contain at least 24 credits not counted for another major/minor and each minor at least nine. If used as a cognate, these credits cannot also count in another cognate. Only general electives may use Credit Only; transfer toward the major/minor needs written department approval.

outcomes.text: Program efficiently in Python and Java using appropriate data structures.
Analyze large datasets and apply AI methods and specialized tools.
Apply data science and AI beyond computing and mathematics while considering ethics.

notes: Degree curriculum is taken from the Curriculum tab, not the sample semester plan or the Additional Major tab. Sample-plan totals and courses may differ from the requirements table.
Published ranges remain in notes; they are not converted into invented scalar course credits. Credit unit normalization is unresolved.
The elective pools are represented as choices by published credit amount, not as all required courses. EPS 351 / PSY 292 is retained as an alternative where the BA table presents it.
A non-STEM minor/second major applies to the BA only; BS quantitative coursework and degree total are separately sourced.
